items.title: Earnest Money Deposit
items.description: Deposit EMD of Rs 7,500 online; without it the bid is rejected.

provenance.verbatimQuote: The bidder shall deposit Earnest Money of Rs. 7,500 through online payment, failing which the bid shall be rejected.

items.title: Physical originals deadline
items.description: Originals of bid security and power of attorney must reach by 28 Nov 2026 11:00.

provenance.verbatimQuote: The original Bid Security and Power of Attorney shall be submitted so as to reach the Authority on or before 11:00 hours on 28.11.2026, failing which the Bid shall be rejected.

items.title: Performance Security
items.description: Furnish performance security of 5% of contract value within 30 days of LOA.

provenance.verbatimQuote: The successful bidder shall furnish a Performance Security of 5% of the contract value within 30 days of issue of the Letter of Acceptance.

items.title: Earnest Money amount
items.description: EMD is Rs 12,500 (2.5% of estimated value).

provenance.verbatimQuote: The Earnest Money shall be Rs. 12,500, being 2.5% of the estimated value.

items.title: Non-blacklisting affidavit
items.description: Affidavit on Rs 10 stamp paper, notarised, that the bidder is not blacklisted.

provenance.verbatimQuote: An affidavit on non-judicial stamp paper of Rs. 10, duly notarised, shall be furnished stating that the bidder is not blacklisted.

items.title: Turnover certificate with UDIN
items.description: Statutory auditor certifies turnover in Appendix XI format with UDIN.

provenance.verbatimQuote: The turnover certificate shall be issued by the statutory auditor in the format at Appendix XI with UDIN.

items.title: Performance Security
items.description: Furnish performance security of 3% of contract value.

provenance.verbatimQuote: The Contractor shall furnish a Performance Security of 3% of the contract value.

items.title: Bid validity
items.description: Bid must stay valid for 120 days from the bid due date.

provenance.verbatimQuote: The bid shall remain valid for 120 days from the bid due date.
The Contractor shall rectify all defects for a defect liability period of 24 months.
